description_short: The JRC Summer School on Non-Animal Approaches in Science runs 24-28 May 2027 in Ispra, Italy, for up to 120 participants. Applications, with a motivation section and a flash presentation abstract of up to 250 words, opened 5 November 2026 and close 22 January 2027.
